{{Top|leg}}
Many [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that worked for the [[Exchange]] did not always have the proper key codes for locked doors. The '''exchange interface''' was a solution to that problem - if an individual could find it on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
